expectText: What ERA adoption rate should best-practice organizations target?

set.text: Which electronic transaction pairs with the ERA (835) to create a fully electronic payment cycle?
set.explanation: The ERA explains how a claim was paid, while EFT (electronic funds transfer) delivers the money directly to the provider's bank account. Together they let payments post automatically and be reconciled to bank deposits; the 837 is the outgoing claim and the 270/271 is an eligibility inquiry.

src: No source for a 90%+ ERA adoption "best practice", 1-3% of net revenue recovered from underpayments (only vendor blogs; same claim fixed in payer-contracts), or a 24-48 hour posting rule
